title: Replace unactivated generic Phase 204 with the owner-approved Revenue Activation and Evidence Kernel
root_cause: The prior generic Phase 204 package does not implement the owner's now-approved revenue activation order, provider approval boundaries, internal capability truth, bounded prospecting domain, or workflow-specific evidence kernel.

observed_impact.summary: The phase cannot truthfully activate until its effective contract matches the owner's approved three-packet revenue sequence and external-action limits.

rationale: Owner accepted AMEND-IMP-bea698ba2540f0c8d57f995d-1; schedule the amended phase through normal TaskPacket and release gates.

added_requirements: Apply the evidence kernel only to the two implemented revenue workflows.
Require owner approval before first external publication and preserve provider credential boundaries.
removed_requirements: Execute the prior generic Phase 204 package unchanged.

acceptance_criteria: Both revenue workflows have claim lineage, cost, budget, stop, and outcome controls.
Exact-SHA production deployment, authenticated readback, conditional review, and Phase 204 certification pass without Phase 205 work.
The canonical internal commerce business and required tenant-scoped capabilities are production-verified.
The prospecting MVP supports no more than 25 evidence-backed prospects with human-approved outreach and suppression.
The storefront is live after exact owner approval or one owner/provider blocker is recorded.
amendment_details.commercial_unlock: Authorizes a bounded, evidence-controlled first product storefront and high-ticket audit acquisition workflow without declaring internal ENTRAL software sellable.

supersession_record.reason: The owner explicitly replaced the unactivated generic package with the Revenue Activation and Evidence Kernel while retaining bounded evaluation requirements inside the third TaskPacket.
